summary: The CascadingDropdown class provides a utility method for replacing a dropdown control with static text in web UI scenarios, specifically when cascading dropdowns are disabled and their value should not be displayed as selectable.
purpose: To manage visibility of dropdowns and their corresponding static text representations within a web user interface, especially to handle cases where disabled dropdowns are not loaded and should instead show their selected value as static text.

fields.name: container
fields.description: Parent control containing dropdown and static text controls.

fields.name: dropdownName
fields.description: The ID of the dropdown control to be replaced.

fields.name: literalName
fields.description: The ID of the Literal control to display static text.

workflows.name: Replace Dropdown With Static Text
steps: Locate the dropdown control by its name within the container.
If found, set dropdown control visibility to false.
Locate the static text (Literal) control by its name within the container.
If found, set Literal control visibility to true.

business_rules: If a cascading dropdown is disabled and not loaded, its selected value should not be displayed as selectable but as static text.
validations: Check if the dropdown control exists before setting visibility.
Check if the static text (Literal) control exists before setting visibility.
conditions: Dropdown must be disabled and not loaded to trigger replacement.
system_behavior: Dropdown control becomes invisible when replaced.
Literal control becomes visible to show static text.
dependencies: Control identification by name within container
exceptions: If control is not found by name, no visibility changes occur.
content_gaps: No information on how the static text value is set.
No details on use cases beyond disabled dropdown scenarios.
No explanation for error handling if controls are not present.
